top_signals.title: Asian Bonds, Treasury Futures Rise as Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asia Pacific bonds rose alongside Treasury futures as falling oil prices eased inflation concerns after the US signaled progress in diplomatic efforts to end the war with Iran.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Qantas CEO Vanessa Hudson on Long-Haul Demand
top_signals.summary: Qantas Airways CEO Vanessa Hudson joins Romaine Bostick in New York to discuss the challenges and opportunities facing the business as they look at market demand and rising oil prices. Hudson says they're projecting demand and are confident about their long haul routes. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
